title: EPISTEMIC SUBSTITUTION: HOW GROKIPEDIA’S AI-GENERATED ENCYCLOPEDIA RESTRUCTURES AUTHORITY

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting citation networks from matched Wikipedia and Grokipedia articles, classifying the sources into 8 institutional categories (e.g., Academic, News, User-Generated, Government), and comparing their epistemic profiles, citation density, and topic-dependent sourcing patterns using Jensen-Shannon Divergence, Cosine Similarity, and network analysis.
